Enclave app store: deploy WebAssembly apps on confidential GPUs
App store

Simply pick an app and deploy it.

Browse ready-to-run apps and launch any of them on private, confidential hardware in a couple of clicks. Pay for exactly the time you use - no setup, no subscription. And everything here is open: an app's code and listing can't be swapped out from under you, and you can verify what you're running yourself, before it touches your data. Built something of your own? Publishing it takes a minute, and your app can charge an hourly fee that goes straight to you whenever someone runs it.

App store · publish

Publish a Wasm app version.

Add a wasi:http component release to the on-chain catalog. Its bytes go on IPFS; the CID and metadata go on Base. An app is keyed by slug in your wallet's namespace; publish the same slug again to cut a new version. Only you (msg.sender) can add versions, edit, or delist it. New to building components? The developer guide takes you from an empty directory to a published app.
